segments.sn45.33:1.2: “Yesaṃ kesañci, bhikkhave, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo viraddho, viraddho tesaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
segments.sn45.33:1.3: Yesaṃ kesañci, bhikkhave, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo āraddho, āraddho tesaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
segments.sn45.33:1.4: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo?
segments.sn45.33:1.6: Yesaṃ kesañci, bhikkhave, ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo viraddho, viraddho tesaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
segments.sn45.33:1.7: Yesaṃ kesañci, bhikkhave, ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo āraddho, āraddho tesaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī”ti.

lines: Iti ekaṃ suttaṃ dhammavasena kathitaṃ, ekaṃ puggalavasena.
Pāragāminoti ettha yepi pāraṅgatā, yepi gacchanti, yepi gamissanti, sabbe pāragāminotveva veditabbā.
Yattha yattha pana heṭṭhā ca imesu ca tīsu suttesu “rāgakkhayo”ti āgataṃ, tattha tattha arahattampi vaṭṭatiyevāti vadanti.
Saṃsāramahoghassa paratīrabhāvato yo naṃ adhigacchati, taṃ pāreti gametīti pāraṃ, nibbānaṃ, tabbidhuratāya natthi ettha pāranti apāraṃ, saṃsāroti vuttaṃ –
Ekantakāḷakattā cittassa apabhassarabhāvakaraṇato kaṇhābhijātihetuto ca vuttaṃ “kaṇhanti akusaladhamman”ti.
Vodānabhāvato cittassa pabhassarabhāvakaraṇato sukkābhijātihetuto ca vuttaṃ –
Kilesamāra-abhisaṅkhāramāra-maccumārānaṃ pavattiṭṭhānatāya okaṃ vuccati vaṭṭaṃ, tabbidhuratāya anokanti nibbānanti āha –
Paramatthato samaṇā vuccanti ariyā, samaṇānaṃ bhāvo sāmaññaṃ, ariyamaggo, tena araṇīyato upagantabbato sāmaññattho nibbānanti āha –
